settings.title: Settings
taskbar.label: Taskbar visibility
taskbar.help:
On Windows 11:
1. Click “Open Windows settings…”.
2. Expand “Other system tray icons”.
3. Turn on each “Codex Status Icons” entry you want to see, and use its letter to identify the VS Code window.

On: the icon is visible next to the clock.
Off: the icon is in the hidden icon menu (^).
taskbar.failure: Unable to open Windows settings. Open Settings > Personalization > Taskbar.
stale_working_minutes.label: Session status expiration
stale_working_minutes.help: After this long without new Codex activity, its status is no longer considered recent: the icon turns grey. New activity lets its status appear again.
